frozen_before: PCS learned-policy search on these data claims
prior_inspection: Berkeley published counts and eight direct Lean arithmetic checks were inspected in a feasibility check; no blindness or novelty is claimed.

berkeley.reference: Bickel et al. (1975), Berkeley admissions 1973, six largest departments

iris.split: within each species, every fifth source row is test; remaining rows train
iris.classifier: exact integer 1-nearest-neighbor on feature values in tenths; lowest source ID wins ties
iris.contamination: append source row 1 from training to the evaluation set
iris.claims: source-ID overlap and finite exact classifier replay; no population generalization claim

resnet.preprocessing: demo-specific nearest-neighbor resize to 224x224 using floor(x*sourceWidth/224), floor(y*sourceHeight/224), RGB; Float32 divide by255, subtract Float32 ImageNet mean, divide by Float32 ImageNet std. This is not the official ImageNet accuracy recipe.
resnet.gate: all seven recorded logit vectors finite with exactly 1000 classes; original reference class exceeds every competing class by at least 1.0 logits in every view
resnet.float_observation: exact binary32 bit patterns interpreted as signed integers scaled by 2^-149; mathematical checking never rounds scores
resnet.gate_scope: finite observed views only, no truth, calibrated confidence, out-of-distribution or universal robustness guarantee
resnet.runtime_correspondence: empirically compare PyTorch CPU, ONNX CPU and actual browser WASM; same top labels and guard outcomes required; predeclared logits atol=0.001 and rtol=0.001
